ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated in distal-lateral regions against low-intensity black pixels in medial and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones located on the upper-outer quadrants of both lobes, transitioning into high-frequency mottled black-and-white patterns towards the center. The medial-proximal region and the extreme trailing edge are predominantly solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated acute angle of approximately 40 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased frequency of pixel-level peaks and valleys observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve that tapers into slightly hooked, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected at the extreme distal tips and scattered sparsely within the dark medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, parallel diagonal dark lines (rake marks) disrupting the high-intensity white field on the viewer's left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular contouring at the extreme distal tips indicating minor tissue loss or persistent bio-fouling residue.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique feathered transition zone between black and white fields on the viewer's right lobe, characterized by longitudinal streaks of low-intensity pixels.
